title: really big
text: really big. I purchased the 82q and it's a very nice, wide mouth size and plenty deep for a large family boil.  The stainless is heavy. I haven't run a magnet over it to see how nice the stainless is, but it feels and looks sturdy.  The handles (side and lid) are not riveted, but they seem pretty solid.  The lid sits down solidly on the outer pot.  The basket sits below the lid so it doesn't cause any lid issues.  If I have any issues when we fire it up, I will update this review.  The pot arrived quickly (I have Prime) and in good condition.  It was in a box, inside a box and well padded.

product_metadata.title: Bayou Classic 1124 24-qt Stainless Stockpot w/ Lid And Basket Includes Vented Lid Perforated Stainless Steel Basket Perfect For Steaming Boiling and Frying
features: Perforated Basket that sets 3-in above the bottom for steaming or boiling
description: The good outdoor life is served with a Bayou Classic 24-qt Stainless Stockpot. Small holes in basket are perfect for pasta, and to blanch fresh peas and other vegetables prior to canning. Use with basket to boil or steam shrimp, seafood, corn, vegetables, and tamales. Fry fish, chicken, hushpuppies, onions and fries. Use without basket for soup, low country boil, gumbo, stews, and chili. Also, enjoy barrels of fun when concocting malt extract Home Brew. Whatever the occasion, make every outing a refuge for food, fun and fellowship with Bayou Classic; you’ll be back for seconds! Note: This 24-qt stockpot pars well with Bayou Classic Patio Stove models SQ14, 1114; and tall cooker models SP50, SS50; and Dual Burner Cooker model DB375; and Triple Burner Cooker model TB650.
